questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 24 cm and a height of 6 cm. Slow down and work through it step by step: what is its area?

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: From a while back — in Lord of the Flies, what does Piggy's role mainly show about the group?

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: If 50g of reactants react fully in a sealed container, what is the mass of the products?
questions.why: Mass is conserved in a closed system, so the total mass of products equals the total mass of reactants: 50g.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What is it called when a gas forms and causes bubbling during a reaction?
questions.why: Bubbling, or effervescence, happens when a gas is produced during a reaction — a clear sign a chemical change has occurred.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: Why do cereal ads often use cartoon mascots aimed at children?
questions.why: Cartoon mascots make a product feel fun and friendly to children, encouraging them to want it regardless of its nutritional value.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: On a nutrition label, which column shows the amount in one serving?
questions.why: The 'per serving' column shows how much of each nutrient is in a single serving, as opposed to the standard 100g comparison.
